name: watchbox
api_token: Cloudflare API token: Workers Scripts edit, Workers Routes edit, D1 edit, Zone DNS edit, Account Settings read
access_api_token: optional: a separate token with Access: Apps and Policies edit, Identity Providers edit (else api_token needs those too)
storage_values_file: path to cloudflare-values.txt from the storage installer (or fill "storage" below)
box_values_file: optional: path to cloudflare-values.txt from the download-box installer
